content:
Liam: onboarding AstraNimbus-7B (hf tar) 10% degradation vs Gemma on our streaming eval. suspect token-id gaps + per-head rotary scale differences.
Rina: what do you mean by gaps?
Liam: tokenizer has reserved special tokens inserted mid-vocab (e.g., <mask> at id 5024), which pushed subsequent ids but the model's embeddings were exported with contiguous indices. result: embedding matrix index != tokenizer id in some ranges.
Jorge: oof. any quick checksum we can run?
Liam: did a range checksum that highlights offsets:
```
# quick map check
for start in range(0,32000,1024):
    sum_vocab = sum(vocab_ids[start:start+1024])
    sum_emb = sum(emb_index[start:start+1024])
    print(start, sum_vocab - sum_emb)
# output shows blocks with +1 and -2 offsets
```
Rina: that explains weird repeated tokens in samples. how does rotary fit?
Liam: model.config has per_head_rope_scale = [1.0]*half + [0.95]*half (headwise). our runtime only had scalar rope_freq_scale globally. when combined with token-index misalignment you get phase collisions on some attention heads.
qe-bot: quick eval (1000 prompts): AstraNimbus int8 baseline: ppl=17.9, top-1 repeat=6.8%. Gemma int8 baseline: ppl=15.6, repeat=2.9%.
Jorge: do we have int4 numbers?
qe-bot: AstraNimbus int4 (naive quant): ppl=22.4, repeat=12.1%. With embedding-remap patch + headwise-rope shim: ppl=16.7, repeat=3.1%.
Rina: nice improvement. what did the shim do?
Liam: we added a compatibility layer that: 1) detects token-id discontinuities and creates an emb_index map, 2) applies per-head rope scaling by reading model metadata if present, falling back to global value. This avoids re-exporting immediately.
Jorge: can you share the detection snippet?
Liam: paste:
```python
# detect_offsets.py (toy)
def find_offsets(vocab_ids, emb_index):
    offsets = []
    for i in range(0, len(vocab_ids), 512):
        delta = sum(vocab_ids[i:i+512]) - sum(emb_index[i:i+512])
        if abs(delta) > 0:
            offsets.append((i, delta))
    return offsets
```
Rina: we should add an automated conversion mode that either remaps or fails loudly with suggested fixes. also add a test vector that includes mid-vocab special tokens.
Jorge: operationally, prefer remap-with-warning so hosted users don't break silently. docs need to call out headwise-rope metadata.
devops-bot: job #conv-789 started: astra-conversion-smoke (int4 path).
Liam: next steps I propose: 1) include emb-id remap in convert pipeline (opt-out flag), 2) runtime support for headwise rope_scale, 3) unit tests: checksum ranges + a small suite for quantization stability (int8/int4), 4) post-conversion report with %blocks shifted and suggested action.
Rina: also add a small eval that diffs Gemma/Groundtruth on a shared prompt set so we can quantify regressions in CI.
Jorge: I'll own the runtime flag change. Liam, can you draft the convert PR and include the detection logs + sample outputs?
Liam: yeah, will open a PR with the remap patch + smoke eval before EOD.
qe-bot: conv-789 finished: preliminary int4 smoke: 3 failing checks (quant stability), see artifacts.
Liam: grabbing artifacts now. thanks all.
